subject.title: Feature Request: Token Efficiency & Agent UX Improvements (Agent Perspective)

question: Should this broad umbrella remain open as a coordination tracker until the bootstrap/context and metadata-delivery slices are resolved, or should maintainers split the remaining work into narrower canonical issues and then close the umbrella?
rationale: The remaining gaps are real, but the requested shape spans public config semantics, prompt/session behavior, outbound privacy, cron policy, plugin discovery, and update UX, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Split
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination item while maintainers explicitly assign the bootstrap/context and metadata-delivery slices to canonical trackers or PRs.

options.title: Split Then Close
options.body: Create or bless narrower canonical issues for every remaining slice, link the production evidence from this issue, and then close this umbrella as superseded.

options.title: Close Only After Implementations Land
options.body: Wait until the open bootstrap/context trackers and outbound metadata PR or replacement are resolved before closing this issue as implemented or superseded.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Split
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination item while maintainers explicitly assign the bootstrap/context and metadata-delivery slices to canonical trackers or PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: They show the strongest combined history across heartbeat/subagent context behavior, current line blame, and prior maintainer-side reviews of this issue family.
